lines: Raat ke dhai baje, Papa ke pair zameen se do inch upar hawa mein tair rahe the!
Ananya ka dil dahal gaya... par ye kahani shuru hui do ghante pehle.
Ara Junction ke us sunsan station par ghana kohra chhaya hua tha.
Unnees saal ki Ananya apne Papa Ramesh ke saath aakhri train ka intezar kar rahi thi.
Papa bahut shant the... na kuch kha rahe the, na phone chhoo rahe the.
Beta, bas us laal signal ko dekhti raho... bench se bilkul mat uthna.
Tabhi door sadak se ek ambulance ki laal batti chamakne lagi.
Ek police officer chillaya, 'Ramesh ji ka accident ho gaya hai, wo nahi rahe!'
Ananya ne ghabrakar neeche dekha... Papa ke joote zameen ko chhoo hi nahi rahe the!
Train se bacha liya tumhe beta... ab madad aa gayi hai, main chalta hoon.
Papa ki rooh Ananya ko surakshit team ke haath saumpkar kohre mein gayab ho gayi.
